images.note: Real screen capture — Properties panel scoped to the package ("checkpoint Package"), Checkpoints category expanded: CheckpointFileName set to C:\temp\checkpoint.xml, CheckpointUsage set to IfExists, SaveCheckpoints set to True. The single best shot of all three properties together. Verified with curl -sI (image/png) and an md5 match against the live URL.

Real screen capture — Properties panel on a Data Flow task, FailPackageOnFailure row selected and set to True, with the tooltip description visible ("Indicates whether the package fails when the executable fails"). Verified with curl -sI (image/png) and an md5 match.

Real screen capture — two task groups side by side after a run: Task 1 (Source Table to Destination table, 6 rows, both green) succeeded, Task 2 (Source Table 1 to OLE DB Destination, 6 rows) failed at the destination. Illustrates exactly the partial-failure scenario checkpoints are built for. Verified with curl -sI (image/png) and an md5 match.

Real screen capture — the package re-run after the checkpoint file was in place: Data Flow Task and Update Records both show green success icons on the retry. Verified with curl -sI (image/png) and an md5 match.
